mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.strategy_id, c.user_id, u.nickname AS author_name, u.avatar AS author_avatar, c.parent_id, c.content, c.like_count, c.create_time FROM strategy_comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.strategy_id = #{strategyId} AND c.parent_id = 0 AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC

SELECT c.id, c.strategy_id, c.user_id, u.nickname AS author_name, u.avatar AS author_avatar, c.parent_id, c.content, c.like_count, c.create_time FROM strategy_comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.parent_id = #{parentId} AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.create_time ASC
